The '''Insta-Meal''' was a type of processed [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and contained large amounts of essential nutrients. It was usually sold in small blocks allowing for pieces to be broken off and consumed independently. Its packaging allowed it to be easily transported<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> and stored in [[survival pack]]s.<ref name="Song for a Fallen" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' "describes the state of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Universe/Legends|universe]] at the end of the first movie, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars IV: A New Hope'']]." This [[Time/Legends|time]] period corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Wenny Boggs]], a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], brought a hunk of Insta-Meal when he traveled into the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]].<ref name="Song for a Fallen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Insta-Meal appeared in the short narrative "[[Song for a Fallen Nomad]]," originally published by [[West End Games]] in the [[1987]] ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]]. <ref name="Song for a Fallen" />
